intro: Village Draw creates one restart-safe community giveaway at a time. Viewer Foundation owns points; Village Draw owns only bounded entries, recovery records, and draw receipts. Start with free single entry unless you intentionally want points tickets.

sections.title: 1. Start here
sections.description: Keep the feature disabled until Viewer Foundation and the commands are ready.
sections.notice: Village Draw is for casual community giveaways. Do not use it for paid entry, gambling, regulated drawings, or high-value prizes without obtaining appropriate professional guidance.

sections.title: 2. Describe the giveaway
sections.description: This information appears in chat and on the hosted overlay.

sections.title: 3. Entry and ticket rules
sections.description: Free single entry is the simplest and safest default. Points modes spend Viewer Foundation points.

sections.title: 4. Viewer commands
sections.description: Command Sync creates matching no-response actions. Giveaway management must remain Moderator or Broadcaster only.

sections.title: 5. Chat announcements
sections.description: Opening, winner, and cancellation messages go to selected chats. Entry confirmation returns only to the viewer's source platform.
sections.notice: Tokens: {name}, {prize}, {entryCommand}, {winner}, {viewer}, {tickets}, {points}, and {currency}. Final messages are clamped separately for Twitch, YouTube, Kick, and TikTok.

sections.title: 6. Overlay appearance
sections.description: The same responsive URL works in OBS, Meld, and Streamlabs Desktop.
